controllerDescriptions.Answer: Operations to return Answer-related information. These endpoints will be used for altering or modifying fields related to answers only. This does not include publishing an answer since that is question-dependent.
controllerDescriptions.ExternalActivity: Provides Mechanisms to Create, Modify, Delete External Activity records.
controllerDescriptions.ExternalSearch: POST Endpoints for adding external items to the Higher Logic Search Index results. Note that External Search Endpoints are available as an add-on and they require a separate IAMKey for access.
controllerDescriptions.Volunteer: Endpoints related to the Volunteer Module.
